eyebrow: A little direction goes a long way
headline: You don’t have to figure out the next step alone.
subcopy: Student-led consultations can help you clarify what you’re looking for and turn a big goal into a more manageable plan.

options.label: 1-on-1 Opportunity Mapping
options.summary: Not sure where to begin? Share your interests and goals. We’ll review your request and, where possible, help you identify a practical next step.
deliverables: Explore opportunities related to your interests
Filter high-signal competitions, fellowships, and fairs
Match your current grade level to realistic timelines

options.label: Research & Competition Roadmap
options.summary: Turn a broad curiosity in AI, STEM, or entrepreneurship into a sequenced set of milestones from initial idea to submission.
deliverables: Figure out a useful place to start
Map pathways toward IRIS, IEEE, and national innovation challenges

options.label: Application & Eligibility Review
options.summary: Avoid last-minute surprises by verifying requirements, team rules, and documentation before you commit hours to an application.
deliverables: Verify organiser rules, fees, and Hyderabad/online formats
